name: Crypto stress
summary: Binance withdrawals reopened 1 Nov after $6.3bn theft, with heavy outflows; Bitcoin 12% below its high
state: Binance lifted its withdrawal suspension on 1 Nov and saw about $4.6bn withdrawn against $1.0bn deposited between 06:00 and 15:30 UTC that day (ABC News). North Korea denied on 3 Nov the FBI's finding that it stole about $6.3bn from the exchange, as researchers trace the funds (CNBC). Bitcoin was near $76,500 on 3 Nov, 12% below its high, so the Watch status rests on the exchange's continuing stress.
for_you: Binance customers may still see delays on some withdrawals. Any shortfall in reserves would matter most for those holding funds on the exchange.
rubric_hit: Top-10 exchange under stress (Binance outflows after theft) = Watch; BTC drawdown 12% < 25%
basis_detail: raised above the data floor on reported events

sources.title: ABC News — North Korea denies Binance heist as customers withdraw billions
CNBC — North Korea denies links to Binance hack as researchers trace funds

why: Crypto is now plumbed into mainstream finance via ETFs and stablecoins; a crash or de-peg can spill into funding markets.
drivers: Liquidity, leverage, regulation, stablecoin reserves, exchange solvency.

rubric.alert: Drawdown > 45%, or a major stablecoin de-pegs (> 3% for > 24h), or a top-10 exchange fails.
rubric.watch: Drawdown 25–45%, or a top-10 exchange/stablecoin under stress.
rubric.normal: Bitcoin drawdown from 52-week high < 25% and no major stablecoin/exchange incidents.
